sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
details equipment inspection steps I2, which must be performed every six months 
bases indicated by M6 in the title block.

This pump is used for 
supply the boiler with mazout.

The first draft initiated 
by eng . Abdalla M. Abdalla. reviewed by director eng. Gamal Arafa, tested by 
eng. Ibrahem Sherqawy Hassan, accepted by Mohamed Abdel Salam general director, 
and approved by eng. Michael Goerge. Head sector of Ayoun Moussa steam 
power station 2x320 MW.

This document is accepted by eng. Samir 
Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant; Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General 
Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
